subject: Andhra Pradesh life tax new motor cycle scooter two wheeler rate
text: Andhra Pradesh life tax on a new motor cycle, tri-cycle or scooter: 9% of the cost if the cost does not exceed Rs.50,000, 12% if it exceeds Rs.50,000. Rates from the 2021 amending bill; the date it took effect by notification isn't held. A 10% Road Safety Cess on the life tax is added from 13 January 2026.

source.doc: Andhra Pradesh Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Bill, 2021, L.A. Bill No.23 of 2021, Gazette 23 November 2021, Third and Sixth Schedules

subject: Andhra Pradesh life tax new motor car jeep three or four wheeler rate
text: Andhra Pradesh life tax on a new non-transport three or four wheeler, including motor cars and jeeps: 13% of the cost below Rs.5 lakh, 14% from Rs.5 lakh to below Rs.10 lakh, 17% from Rs.10 lakh to below Rs.20 lakh, 18% at Rs.20 lakh or above. Rates from the 2021 amending bill; the date it took effect by notification isn't held. A 10% Road Safety Cess on the life tax is added from 13 January 2026.

source.doc: Andhra Pradesh Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Bill, 2021, L.A. Bill No.23 of 2021, Gazette 23 November 2021, Third and Sixth Schedules

subject: Andhra Pradesh Road Safety Cess on life tax rate
text: Andhra Pradesh Road Safety Cess: 10% of the life tax payable, collected at registration, on motor cycles, motor cars and cabs, four-wheeled goods carriages below 3000 kg GVW, construction equipment vehicles and other vehicles that pay life tax. Applies from 13 January 2026. Passage of the replacing bill is reported in the press, not yet confirmed from an official copy of the act.

source.doc: Andhra Pradesh Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Ordinance No.1 of 2026, Gazette 13 January 2026, Tenth Schedule; L.A. Bill No.14 of 2026
